**Live file swap: static only.** disc rebuild + session swap; live_inject only unpacks PRS/Yaz0/AFS/BML, not SoulCalibur's LZ/olnk

**Pick whip: none.** no SoulCalibur entity backend; generic colour region / slot guess only
